0022600149.text: The Hawks (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) are on the road for their 7th game of the season, with a 2-1 road record and a 3-3 mark over their last ten. The Pelicans (1-4, 12th in the West) are 4 games back in the Southwest, with a 1-2 home record and an 0-2 mark at home-court opponents' arenas, so to speak, and they have won their most recent game. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 117-100 win in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
